news.text_before: ELLIS Unit NRW at ECCV 2026: ten papers feature contributions from our unit. Explore the full author lists and poster session schedule.
Registration to the CESOC/ ELLIS Unit NRW workshop "How Resolution Matters: The Future of AI Climate Modelling" is now open. The workshop will take place on November 6, 2026, in Cologne, Germany.
The ELLIS Unit NRW officially has launched.  We are proud to join the ELLIS network.
Join the AutoML Summer School 2026 @ TU Dortmund University, July 27-31, 2026.
